modules.module_title: Perform Installation and Configuration of IIoT devices and Products

pcs.pc_description: get the list of sensors and other devices to install and their locations
get the installation drawings and instructions for each sensor or device – including wiring and interconnection list and diagram
read the drawing and instructions and ensure that you understand – else seek clarifications and clarify all doubts
prepare a list of all parts and accessories required for the installation
collect all sensors, devices, cables, and other accessories required for the installation
inform the person in-charge of the site (whether belonging to your company or the client) and take permission to do the installation

inspect the site and ensure that the site is ready for installation – in particular, check that the equipment on which sensors or devices are to be installed are in place and are available for installation

perform any site preparations – identify, verify and mark installation location and equipment on drawing, mark locations of holes for support members, drill correct size holes, mark cable entry and exit points, mounting and routing of cable reliefs, cable trays, cable trenches etc.
install brackets and other hardware for supporting the sensors or devices according to installation drawings, using approved accessories and hardware
install securely sensors or devices according to installation drawings on the equipment or support members as specified in the drawings

follow specified procedure for mounting of sensor on the equipment – such as inserting the sensor inside the equipment to correct depth or mounting it on a specified surface using specified mounting hardware and using any surfactant compound (such as thermal grease)
install wireless sensors following specified procedure, ensuring proper connection of power source or battery and correct orientation of antenna
fix any labels, tags, or other markings to identify the devices
cross check installed devices with list provided for correct location, orientation, and any other distinguishing features

modules.module_title: Interconnecting Devices using Specified Cables and Accessories

pcs.pc_description: prepare specified wires and cables of required lengths using recommended practices and terminate on lugs, pins, connectors etc. as specified in drawings – for each sensor or input device to the destination device or junction box
use fiber optic cable of correct types, sizes, and lengths for optical connections
follow specified procedures and protection devices for laying fiber cables and ensure minimum bending radius guidelines
follow colour codes, labelling and ferruling practices for all wires and cables
use industry best practices for installation or wiring where detailed instructions are missing

run wires and cables through the cable entry and exit points, routing via specified cable hose, tray, trench etc. and bring them to the target junction boxes, sensors, or devices, control panels, PLCs etc.
use appropriate cable glands, cable ties, clips, clamps or other specified strain relief or protection device
connect the wire and cable ends to sensors and devices as specified in connection list

follow wiring procedure specified for any Fieldbus devices – consisting of sensors, devices, junction boxes, terminators, power conditioner and host controller. These are normally connected using shielded twisted copper pair connections

follow wiring procedure specified for any Power over Ethernet (POE) connected sensors, devices, terminators, power conditioner and controller, which are normally connected using CAT5/CAT6 wires of specified gauges for the intended length

connect PoE types of powered devices (PDs) to Ethernet networks using specified CAT5 or CAT6 cables and RJ45 connectors following recommended procedure. Such devices include IP surveillance cameras, 802.11ac and 802.11ax access points, LED luminaires, 5G small cells, VoIP phones, and other IoT appliances
ensure correct connection type - T568A or T568B - for all PoE devices as specified in the connection diagram
terminate optical fiber cables on specified connectors using appropriate cutting, stripping and termination tools
verify that all screws are tightened with correct torque and the devices are rigidly mounted to withstand any expected vibration, wind velocity and operational handling
verify that devices do not physically interfere with other equipment or wiring and have specified environmental protection, dust covers, orientation and access
verify all connections for physical integrity, labelling, colour coding and compliance with the connection list
verify correct termination of shields and ground connections
perform DC continuity check and verify all connections with the connection list
confirm that DC resistance is within specified limits where applicable
verify insulation resistance of cables and connections using insulation tester, where applicable
verify integrity of fiber optic connections using appropriate tools. Verify minimum bending radius guidelines
prepare installation report in prescribed format and submit to authorized persons

modules.module_title: Collate and analyze Data arising out of a manufacturing process

pcs.pc_description: collect data from various sources such as sensors, PLCs, SCADA systems, and databases.
Ensuring high data quality by implementing processes for data cleaning, normalization, and validation.
utilizing statistical analysis techniques and machine learning algorithms to derive actionable insights from manufacturing data.
identify patterns, trends, and correlations relevant to optimizing manufacturing processes.
Demonstrate accuracy and reliability of predictive models developed for forecasting equipment failures, predicting production outputs, or optimizing process parameters.
Create clear and informative visualizations, dashboards, and reports to communicate insights effectively.
Design visualizations that are intuitive and actionable for decision-makers across different levels of the organization.
conduct root cause analysis to identify factors contributing to manufacturing inefficiencies, defects, or downtime.
Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) and industry-specific standards (e.g., ISO 9001, IEC 62443) in data handling and analysis.
Implement best practices for data governance, access control, and audit trails to maintain data integrity and security.

pcs.pc_description: follow instructions of commissioning personnel to set up the test systems
follow electrical, electronic, mechanical, and other safety requirements and procedures
use protective gear and tools – such as helmets, goggles, proper gloves, shoes etc. required for the task
read and report instrument data as instructed
follow instructions regarding loop testing
perform any changes or modifications to the installation as instructed and record the changes in appropriate documents
perform disconnection of the test setup, restore normal connections and any clean up when instructed
provide support to the commissioning team in performing user acceptance test

pcs.pc_description: collect the design documents and understand the assembly and test procedure
verify that circuit diagram, BOM and assembly instructions are clear and complete
use recommended ESD protected work bench, wrist band and grounding procedure
collect all parts for the design according to BOM

confirm that all tools required for assembly are available – including soldering and de soldering tools, SMD soldering tools (such as hot air blower, hot tweezer etc.), PCB holder, magnifier, illumination lamp, flux liquid or paste, tweezer, pliers, cutters, cleaning solvent, brush etc.
report any missing, damaged, or spare components or tools to supervisor and get missing parts and clarifications

modules.module_title: Performing assembly of PCB and enclosure

pcs.pc_description: set correct temperature for normal or SMD soldering tools. Set correct air flow rate for SMT soldering
perform assembly of electronic parts on the PCB taking care of the correct orientation of part on the PCB, according to layout and following industry best practices
verify correctness of assembly and ensure that there are no unused parts or shortages
clean the assembled PCB using recommended solvent and dry the PCB following recommended procedure
prepare required cables, connectors, harnesses etc. using recommended wires, accessories, and tools
mount components on the chassis, enclosure, box etc. per given design
solder chassis components and plug cables in appropriate places

confirm availability of appropriate testing tools such as power supply, signal generator, oscilloscope, dc voltage reference etc. for testing as specified and verify that these are in good working conditions
perform visual check to verify current location, orientation, and polarity of all components on the PCB and chassis
perform multimeter test to ensure that the input power supply lines to the chassis and PCB are not shorted
use fuse links of appropriate ratings
use appropriate power supply to power the device
ensure that the required connectivity is available and credentials are provided for testing wireless or internet connected devices
perform testing of PCB and chassis following step by step testing instructions provided
note any unusual heating of parts, smoke or burning smell – if found, switch off power supply immediately and investigate
record observations and test results in prescribed format
cross check any failed tests with instructions and verify that the test result is correct
consult supervisor or test engineer for any clarifications – especially if there are any failed tests, failed component or in consistent data
switch off all instruments and clean up the work bench on completion of test
follow safety norms and practices and report any non-compliance

modules.module_title: Work in a disciplined and ethical manner

pcs.pc_description: perform tasks as per workplace standards, organizational policies and legislative requirements
display appropriate professional appearance at the workplace and adhere to the organizational dress code

demonstrate responsible and disciplined behavior at the workplace such as punctuality; completing tasks as per given time and standards; demonstrating professional behavior at all times, adopting environment- friendly practices, etc.
identify the cause of conflict and options for resolution with peers or escalate grievances and problems to appropriate authority as per procedure for conflict resolution
protect the rights of the client and organization when delivering services
ensure services are delivered equally to all clients regardless of personal and cultural beliefs
operate within an agreed ethical code of practice and report unethical conduct to the appropriate authorities
follow organizational guidelines and legal requirements on disclosure and confidentiality

identify and report discrimination and harassment based on gender, disability, or cultural difference at the workplace
use inclusive or neutral language and gestures in all interactions
respect the personal and professional space of others
access grievance redressal mechanisms as per legislations

modules.module_title: Adhere to standard safety procedures of the organisation

pcs.pc_description: comply with general safety procedures and those for handling equipment, tools, chemicals, and hazardous material, as prescribed and followed in the organisation
remove finger rings or any other metal objects likely to interfere with the work
ensure that identification badge or any other object worn around the neck or on the clothing does not get caught in any rotating machine, or otherwise interfere with the work
use appropriate safety devices such as goggles, gloves, ear plugs, caps, ESD pins, covers, shoes, helmets etc. recommended for the work being performed
inform, escalate, or raise alarm about any suspicions, unaccounted hazardous material, devices, or other objects found in the premises
inform, escalate, or raise alarm about any breach of safety or security procedure in the organisation
help achieve zero accidents goals at work
avoid damage to sensitive electronic components due to negligence of ESD procedures
participate regularly in fire drills or other safety related workshops organised by the organisation

follow strictly all access control and perimeter safety procedures in designated factory areas such as robotic work stations, automated production lines, automated material movement and other potentially risky operations
ensure that other people follow all access control and perimeter safety procedures in designated factory areas and help avoid accidents
use emergency switches or other mechanisms of stopping a machine immediately in case any emergency situation has developed or about to happen
ensure that electrical equipment are properly grounded
follow Cyber Security guidelines and be vigilant at workplace
proceed to designated safe assembly area immediately on hearing fire alarm
wash hands and use sanitizers as recommended to prevent spread of diseases
follow common personal hygiene practices
maintain appropriate posture, especially in long hours of sitting or standing position and in handling heavy materials
participate in company organised health sessions such as exercises, games, yoga, physiotherapy, and other activities
handle heavy and hazardous materials with care, while maintaining appropriate posture, using suitable tools, and handling equipment such as trolleys, jacks, and ladders
learn and apply first aid devices available in the workplace
learn and apply safety and handling procedures for electrical shock and electrocution
learn and apply emergency medical help services
follow workplace decorum and avoid emotional outbursts or inappropriate language
prevent any harassment at workplace
identify recyclable, non-recyclable, and hazardous waste generated in the workplace and comply with their disposal procedures
dispose non-recyclable waste and hazardous waste following recommended processes
deposit recyclable and reusable material at identified locations
support education and compliance of waste management processes
identify ways to optimize usage of material and resources such as water, electricity, energy in various tasks, activities, and processes
check for spills and leakages of material in various tasks, activities, and processes and plug them
escalate the leakage issue to appropriate authority if needed
carry out routine cleaning of tools, machines, and equipment and maintain them in good working condition to optimize efficiency and wastage
check if the equipment is functioning normally before commencing work and rectify or report any malfunctioning to the responsible agency

check for any odour, sparks, fumes, emission, unusual vibration, noise, or any other objectionable presence in the environment and take immediate corrective action followed by report to responsible agency
ensure electrical equipment are properly connected for use and are switched off when not in use
support education and compliance of resource conservation processes
